name: Sunlit Thicket

spots.label: Leave
spots.title: Back to the trail
spots.text: Head back down the trail to the village?

spots.label: Read
spots.title: Sunlit Thicket
spots.text: F1 · Sunlit Thicket. Mind the stream, keep to the trail. The old gate north leads to Fernwood.

spots.label: Inspect
spots.title: Fernwood Trail
spots.text: Bars of old light seal the arch. The carving reads: F2 · Fernwood Trail. Come back stronger (Lv. 5).

spots.label: Inspect
spots.title: A glint in the moss
spots.text: Trail runes, faintly glowing under the moss. Someone passed this way not long ago.

spots.label: Look
spots.title: The pond
spots.text: Lily pads and a lazy frog. The water is clear and very cold.

objective: Explore the Thicket and find the way to Fernwood Trail
